question: Explain ABC analysis as a technique of inventory control and its advantages.
sources: Material cost: selective inventory control (ABC analysis)

points.label: Meaning
points.description: Inventory items are classified into A, B and C categories according to their annual consumption value.
points.basis: ABC analysis: classification by consumption value

points.label: The three categories
points.description: A items are few in number but high in value and get strict control; C items are many but low in value and get simple control; B items fall in between.
points.basis: ABC analysis: categories A, B and C

points.label: Selective control
points.description: Control effort is matched to the value of items, so attention goes where most money is tied up.
points.basis: ABC analysis: principle of selective control

points.label: Advantages
points.description: Reduces investment in inventory, saves time and effort in control, and gives closer control over costly items.
